# Global rules

The paragraph below is shared with the project half of this pair, wrapped
differently on purpose so only a normalizing hash can match the two.

Never reproduce a number the model produced; every figure shown to a person must
trace back to the database, the probe, or the scanner that measured it.

Run the tests before you commit.

This paragraph belongs to the global file alone and must never be reported as a
duplicate of anything, however familiar its shape may look to a reader.
